title: The Disappearance of Ambar Sen
subtitle: A Scholar Vanishes, Secrets Unravel in Calcutta
summary: When the enigmatic Ambar Sen arrives on Feluda’s doorstep with an urgent request, the celebrated detective finds himself drawn into a baffling disappearance. As clues surface and unlikely suspects emerge, Feluda must use his wit and intuition to untangle a web of mystery at the heart of Calcutta. Join him on a journey where every conversation hides a clue and nothing is quite as it seems.
